pick.name: HubSpot CRM
pick.what: Market-standard CRM with marketing, forms, sequences, huge integration set
pick.why: Most mature ecosystem and native integrations; scales from free to enterprise
pick.free_limits: Free: up to 2 users, 1,000 contacts and 1,000 records per other standard object; Starter from USD 7/seat/mo (promotional discounts vary)

best_free.name: Attio (Free)
best_free.what: Flexible data-model CRM with email/calendar sync and API
best_free.why: Most generous free tier: 3 seats, 50,000 records; custom objects
best_free.free_limits: Free: 3 seats, 3 objects, 50,000 records; Plus USD 35/user/mo annual (USD 44 monthly); Pro USD 79 annual (USD 99 monthly)

alts.name: Pipedrive
alts.why: Simple deal-centric UX; no free plan (trial); Lite about USD 14/seat annual per secondary roundups
alts.maintained: pricing page blocked fetch; secondary 2026 roundups

alts.name: Twenty
alts.why: Best exit and ownership; REST/GraphQL + MCP; cloud Pro USD 9/user/mo

candidates.name: Pipedrive
candidates.verdict: Good paid deal CRM, no free plan

candidates.name: Folk
candidates.verdict: Light relationship CRM: Standard USD 24/member/mo annual, 2-week trial, no free plan

decision: HubSpot is the safest long-run system of record because of integrations and breadth, but its free tier is thin. Attio's free tier holds a small team's whole pipeline with an API suited to automation. Pick Twenty for open source and ownership, Pipedrive or Folk for simpler paid UX.
details: Pick changed from Attio to HubSpot (best overall); Attio is now best_free.

verify.note: Re-judged on merit: HubSpot Free (2 users, 1,000 contacts, 1,000 records per other object) is thin but the platform is the most complete; Starter from USD 7/seat/mo with promo. Attio, Pipedrive, Twenty, Folk, Salesforce considered; HubSpot remains a fair 'best overall'.
